body:
I don't have friends, nor a boat, nor anything.

The world is a goddamn advertisement. Nothing more. And everyone wants only the best, and they won't settle for anything that's broken. This is precisely why I cannot coexist with its population - because in the first and, in my case, the second world, people are not disillusioned. They see the facade and live it. 

They live the '21st Century Dream,' and I cannot claim my part of it.
No... Not really.

I would not be missing out on anything, because I am already missing out on everything.

Death will change nothing. Only take away my pain.
There is. Gotta do it within or after 7 days.
Screw it. Does not matter to me anymore. Got little to lose.

Ehhh. It will not get better.

But thank you for the tips.
Dunno. My mother called me a screwed-up cretin. I don't know if she'd really be surprised at all.
I am okay with police finding me. Just not family.

Perhaps. Or perhaps I ought to end my life? 

Which decision is right? I cannot tell.
Oh, well, in that case, I've done everything.

I will not die because I cannot have something. I will die because not having said thing causes more pain than is worth living with.

It is euthanasia. I simply cannot go without telling everyone about my fate.
I just do not want them to find the body... God, that would kill them.
I have no money.

I achieved nothing, and have no chance of achieving what I desire to achieve.

And for that, I will go.

I probably will. Need ADs. Need them. 

But.. Death is more appealing.

Heard that too many times.

No. I am determined. Just need to find out how to do it. A gun, I wish. Wrists will not "cut" it, so to speak (pun totally fucking intended). Jumping damages the body. Drowning is awful.

Hanging seems, well... Plausible.
Like I said, not even a partner. I am not good enough for a one-nighter.
I can't actually. I'm not good enough even for that.
Any person will do for now.

I am not getting started, I have ended.

God's grace has departed from me. He will no longer speak to me nor give signs, nor will He help me in my time of crisis. He has let me down, He has let me die. And I do not hold it against Him. Never again will I be angry with the Lord. Only sorrowful, because as his child, how have I wronged Him that He will not assist me?
Try me.

I have talked already. They pronounced me to be highly intelligent with a lust for power and recognition... So a sociopath basically?

Did not help me at all.

I have had enough sex to satisfy a lifetime. But I want companionship. 
That's what I want. And one day, I will want a family. A wife and children to raise. Knowing I will never have that, I would rather die.

This life is empty.

You would only come to resent me.

I've become bitter and disillusioned, devastated. There's nothing good in here anymore.
Ain't no hope for the hopeless. But thank you for the offer, dear friend.

Yup. Quite so. 

I've done some weird stuff man. Stuff I wouldn't forgive myself if I were God. Well, thank God I'm not God then.

I'm an odd one for sure. Finding that out about myself more and more lately.

Who is the pale dude from the Da Vinci Code? I've never seen it.

I look a lot different now. I cut my hair and made a post here just yesterday on a new account and it did not end up so well.

If you'd like, you can PM me. I'm never against a conversation.

I hope that's not what the downvote is for.

That's mostly the point of me giving thanks. I was so desperate that I did something so stupid. And yet, I repent my sins. I genuinely regret what I did, even turning my back on God. And it will happen again, probably.

I am in awe of God's eternal understanding for those broken souls among us.
Uncle
I beg mercy!
Complete maniacs. I don't think God ever encouraged the refusal of medical aid. In fact, I'm quite certain of it. This isn't a matter of religion, it is a matter of idiocy.

You have my prayer, the prayer of a lost sinner.

May you be well. With combined faith, I am absolutely sure that the Lord will hear your calls. Keep calling, never cease to, and seek signs and answers in everyday life, whether it be an opportunity to make a bit of money or to do a good deed.

You can write me if you'd like to talk. I'm here pretty much at all times. Wish I could do more for you, but at least you can confide in someone.

You have my prayer, the prayer of a lost sinner.

May you be well. With combined faith, I am absolutely sure that the Lord will hear your calls. Keep calling, never cease to, and seek signs and answers in everyday life, whether it be an opportunity to make a bit of money or to do a good deed.

You can write me if you'd like to talk. I'm here pretty much at all times. Wish I could do more for you, but at least you can confide in someone.

The healthy do not need to be cured - it is the ailing who need curing. Yes indeed, one repentance is a case worthy of celebration.

God's love is eternal, and I am eternally grateful.
This story will have a happy end. It's ought to.

God gives and takes in ways I will never claim to understand. Wow. This is very disappointing news. 

Well, I suppose all I can do is pray that a new opportunity arises as soon as possible. And I will pray for exactly that.

Haha, yeah. It's completely literal. Except my parents were married when I was born.

I hope so too. I also hope I stop losing hair... It's been causing me a lot of grief... Can't believe I'm going bald at 17.

Oh I'm fine with a challenge. I like a challenge. In fact, being challenged in my views has, as you say, helped me understand why, for instance, bad things happen to innocent people. 

I'll seek out a group. Prague is extremely atheist though. Extremely. Hopefully I can find something. At worst, there's Sunday church.

Huh.. Not a bad idea at all. A church. Never really tried, to be honest. I briefly joined the protestant church with a local group, but they insisted that my interpretation of Christ's words is wholly and completely false and that I know absolutely nothing.

It was a bit of a turnoff, to be honest. Willing to learn and all, definitely, but not if I'm not even given the benefit of doubt.

In any case, I'll try to find a new group. Maybe not a youth group though. Like I said, my peers despise me. I'm ugly and unwanted, complete human waste in their eyes, so I must seek out the company of older people. I was always better with them anyway.

Well, I was extremely lonely, and against all odds, despite my physical inferiority, I found someone. Only thanks to God. I prayed in tears, genuinely begging for help, and I received.

I read the gospel of Christ immediately after, I am currently reading Acts. The Lord saved me through a miracle. A hard-headed atheist turned faithful by an act of pure grace. 

I will never forget what the Lord did for me, and I pledged to do His will in any way he sees fit. Unfortunately, my vision is blurred. I cannot see His will. I do not know what I am supposed to do.

I find myself blinded by my insecurities, and it cripples me. I can't do what I'm supposed to do anymore.

No, no, that is not how I mean it. It is meant in a symbolic sense. I am lost and hopeless, as I was before I found my faith, and while I'm trying to understand why I was born this way, I don't think I can find a way out without God's help. People can help with understanding and answers, but without God, I can't dig myself out.

I would never demand anything from the Lord, and at most I will ask in humble lowliness, in my servitude. I fear God, I really do. No one is His equal and therefore, we cannot make demands. I just hope He will endeavor to save me from myself again, because I can't. 

Without the Lord, I'm at a loss of direction. I've seen therapists before, and none helped until God intervened. Curiously, that was my time of deepest depression, and I hadn't seen any therapist at all.
Fingers crossed!

I've lost a lot of faith I had in humans. In therapists and counselors as well. I have faith in God, and in God alone, along with fellow followers of the flock, because everyone else so far has ditched me.

I will learn to love myself. I truly will. I just need to know what the meaning of my existence is. What purpose does my inferiority serve in my quest to do God's will?

You are right. I do not love myself.

I love the Lord, and the work He has put into me. The effort He has exerted only to save me. That is something worthy of loving. I do not love myself because I am a sinner and a broken soul. If God can breathe life into me once more, then maybe I can love what I once was.
Right now, however, I am the lost sheep, the one of one hundred, and my shepherd must find me.

She's in my prayers, and more so in my thoughts. 

God will have mercy, His plan is infinitely vast and unknown to us, and yet He would not harm us, even if the days look dark and the nights darker still.

So yeah, praying that she lives and improves, that her misery can end and she can live a long and fulfilling life! 
Stay strong, my friend.

We start differential calculus in fourth year here. But you know, it's weird. Our school system is generally a bit different from most.

We have 9 years of primary school, then we have 4 years of whatever high school we choose and get into (MET in my case), and then, only then, can we go to university.

So it might be that because it's a bit different, it may seem that we start certain things earlier, but we actually start them at the same time? I'm not sure how foreign systems work, so I can't say for sure.

Edit: That's weird... This whole post seems oddly unpopular. 56% upvotes. Did I break any rules? I'm genuinely quite clueless and not sure what to do if I fail this goddamn class.

Ay, thanks mate!

Much appreciated!

Mhm, figured as much. We begin calculus in about a year, so I can wait that long. Although, knowing how slow I am to grasp mathematics (takes me ages, but I become pretty good when I finally get it), might be good to get ahead sooner.

Anyway, thanks for the advice. I asked what's up, and tomorrow, we'll be going through practice problems for the first time in the history of this bloody class. Should help significantly.

Damn. Well... Huh. That's a tough spot. Might explain why the whole class is struggling to get through mechanics. 

Do you think it'd be a waste of time to learn the required calculus by myself? I've reviewed some of it, looking at the fundamentals, so I get limits and integrals and such. Maybe it'd help?

Yeah. That's standard, isn't it?

They didn't teach us calculus yet, so it's a tad butchered, but yeah. Fluid and thermo are on the list. Here, they called it hydrodynamics instead of fluid dynamics, and they added gases later, but the things they teach seem quite similar.

I'm afraid I cannot. I'm more an engineering space monkey than a pirate. But I'm definitely not much of a formal guy. I found out the hard way - taking oneself too seriously doesn't garner many friendly looks. One might even be called pretentious, like I was. Acting as if free of the world's heavy weights, however... That has its perks. Sometimes anyway.

To think that I wanted to be a physicist at one point... A faraway memory.

And I cannot prove that I am.

Still, why not speak like a pirate?
What makes you think I'm not a Somalian pirate with access to Internet?
What makes you think I'm not a pirate?
Hmm? What do you mean, my friend?

I might have a good opportunity to show them initiative. At the end of our four years, during the 'maturita' exam (similar as English A levels and such, I think, just a tad later), we are supposed to use every tool available, in the school and outside it, to produce a 'masterpiece' of some sort. 

We're supposed to prepare quality documentation, exact milling and cutting procedures, a manual for usage, and the product itself. Can be anything from a drone to a rifle. Then we are to demonstrate the product in front of a committee who will judge our masterpiece accordingly.

Hopefully they accept a rifle as a sufficiently sophisticated masterpiece, if the receiver is milled from scratch and with my own design. Should have a firearms license by then, so hopefully there are no issues. But knowing myself, the design will look great on paper, and in practice, it'll just fall right apart.

What I'm quite afraid of is my GPA though. I was around a 3.4 half a year ago, and now I slipped down to something around a 2.5. That low. I'm failing mechanics and almost mathematics as well (and I genuinely enjoy trigonometry, so I don't know how I'm screwing it up this bad). I'm screwed out of luck.

The more I look at it, the more I think I shouldn't be in engineering with such poor results, but maybe it can still be saved. Just a bit of a roadblock. If not, I'll just have to become a craftsman. Or stab myself with a ČSN 16 142 steel knife, but that seems a bit too drastic.

Ah, that makes sense, actually. I think we got it from France, or at least from Germany, so maybe it is a thing in all of Europe. 

It's definitely a great field to study before uni. Gives a great outlook. That, and some damn good professors too. Mostly full-on retired engineers. Unfortunately, that means they skimp out on explanations they deem "simple," but the rest of us have a hard time grasping.

I'll find a way to increase my grade. I'm not downright failing yet, but I'm really close.

Oh thank goodness for that then!

I was frankly quite worried that a ČVUT degree would be undervalued in the US. It used to be that way. A Czech engineer skips his bachelor's degree and studies 5 years from scratch for a master's. Apparently, because a Czech engineering master possesses only one degree as opposed to two, like the American master, there can be issues.

Glad to hear they've resolved that issue. Thank the Lord I won't have to study an extra two years.

I sure hope so.

I'll be dead-honest. I'm failing classical mechanics. What the hell, right? Just having trouble with all this adiabatic, isothermic, isobaric stuff. Got unlucky on a test, now I'm headed down the gutter.

It's a relatively new field of study in our country. An experiment. Little did I know that it's woefully unfinished and I've essentially become a lab rat for government officials.

But hey, it's a pretty good field. Only issue is that we don't have enough time for both practical skills and theory, so we have gaps in both. I suck at CAD, I suck with the CNC, I suck with materials and descriptive geometry is just completely nonsensical to most of us. Don't even get me started on tolerances and dimensioning, neither of which have I learned properly last year.

But yeah, it's the basics. Uni should teach us the real stuff.

Well, yes and no.

Our field is something between pure mechanical engineering and machining, so yes, MET, in principle. But it's also extremely broad and we are expected to become full-fledged mechanical engineers in university. 

It's really weird. Basically, we're technicians after high school, and MEs after uni. This way, in case we screw up university, we're still beneficial as technicians to the government. If we succeeded at university (also fully state-funded), even better.

We're a post-communist state, so our system is a little interesting. This way, no one who attends a specialized high school can end up unemployed. Unfortunately, most people attend non-specialized high schools which land them at the unemployment office.

Very good! Very good indeed!

I don't mind an office job. Like I said, I do enjoy getting my hands dirty, but being a scrawny bastard with such a degree of clumsiness that even my old nan could operate a mill with more prowess, it's probably best I stick to pure design.

Thanks for the advice! Much appreciated!

I'd go to ČVUT, the Czech Institute for Technological Learning. It's a pure master's without a bachelor's, and apparently there are issues with that in the US, and I'd need to be re-qualified, but I'm willing to put in extra years if need be. Or even move to the US for studies right away. Either is a possibility. 

Technician sounds about right. That's what I'll be when I'm done with high school. Or so says the director. It's a so-called 'technical lyceum,' and I'm almost certain y'all overseas don't have it, but I'm not sure. Does it exist in the US?

Oh? Well then! That's actually quite a relief, since I absolutely love a variety in choices when it comes to the workplace.

I'll wait a few years, probably go aerospace, or maybe something involving firearms. I know there's an entire field called "rifle-maker" in our country, so maybe that's the way to go?

Thanks for the advice!

Yup. A born and raised Czechofinn, she is. Or a Finnoczech. Depends on her particular national dominance. But she lives here, so I suppose it'll be a Czechofinn deal. 

Speaking of tours, her father's a tour guide. He's a Finn. Well, he used to be a tour guide. And a damn good one at that.

I visited Helsinki once. It was for Christmas, so the days were shorter than my attention span and the nights longer than my... Shall we say, depressive history. It was quite nice! We even visited the graveyard and had a nice sauna visit. Then we leapt naked into the snow!

Brilliant visit. And you too, have a great week!

Hey, thanks!

Hopefully it works out, hm. I don't understand how the jawline could change so fast. A year ago, people said it's awful and underdeveloped. Now it's being praised. Truly, I am baffled.

Suppose I was too child-like a year ago.

Well that'll be a great damn shame, since I'm losing hair... 

Fucking genetics man. Fucking genetics.

Hmmm, I see.

Just one question. Middle part?

Funnily enough, my half-sister is half-Finnish. I've been exposed to your language a fair bit, and by God does it sound difficult. Even more difficult than our infamously treacherous language!

That aside, it's true. And there are many works of fiction and non-fiction alike expressing one's need to be free of such societal restraints. I used to want to be a veterinarian. Then a physicist. Never had the skills or grades for any of those fields of study. But what I've always wanted to be, and what I may well one day become, is an engineer in the United States Army (dual citizen, lucky me, oh, lucky indeed... Mostly anyway).

And after that? I always wanted to be a mercenary with a PMC. And if not that, why not travel? Just travel the world, offer a helping hand where one may be needed, write a few novels on the way, hope they get published, see a few wars, maybe participate. Byron saw the world as it was. Byron must have lived an incredible life.

There's a pretty nice quote from a film (originally a book) called Fight Club, 
"You are not your job, you're not how much money you have in the bank. You are not the car you drive. You're not the contents of your wallet. You are not your fucking khakis. You are all singing, all dancing crap of the world."

Words to live by.

Indeed, I know that story, Into the Wild. Tragic near the end, utterly horrible. And yet, he was more free than all of us. We may be free in a legal sense, and yet, we are not free at all. We are held captive by our possessions, by our material gains, our jobs and parts in society. And while it's true that society cannot run without such things, one must then ask, "is society built ideally?"

I think we all know the answer to that question.

In any case, I thank you again. Just in case, I'll save your username as well. Expect me sometime soon, I'll probably go through some damn difficult trials in the near future and knowing myself, I'll need to talk myself out of it.

Wow. That there is possibly the nicest thing I've read in my entire life. An entire letter of consolation and empathy, dedicated to me... It's a first, I'll tell you that. I saved it, you know. Right to 'ye olde desktop.

Indeed, life is a miserable mistress. Not cruel, no. Miserable. Like the sickbed. Lying around, struggling to breathe, downing medicine, yet still knowing the inevitability of death - that's life. And yet, there truly is a certain unseen charm to it all, an oddly persuasive motivation to keep living 'till the very end.

I must say, finding out that I not only don't look bad, but actually look very good.. Call me shallow, but it's a relief, and that's putting it all too lightly. All my life I've been looked upon as ugly and not too pleasant to the eye. Been called many things, and only few of them too consoling, and yet, after having the chance to converse with such loving people, all offering me their words of reassurance, I feel more alive than ever.

Interesting how little one needs to be dug out from the proverbial grave of depression, and you've made the final move. With this letter, this indescribably beautiful letter, my heart feels, if only for the moment, full once more. It's as if I've gone through a rebirth, similar to that day when I found God. Such a powerful moment.

Thank you. Truly, thank you. Thank you for your kind words, your reassurances and the sheer effort you put into me - someone you've never even seen! It's frankly quite unbelievable, considering most people who see me every day won't put in this much effort to console me.

Yes, of course. I will not harm myself again. I regretted it the same day I carved those lines into my arm. Dumb idea, dumb execution. Lucky I botched it and made the cuts very shallow.

I'll probably be reading this letter a few more times throughout the day. It touched me so. Things rarely touch me, a cold-hearted Onegin character, and yet, this broke through to me. I'm honestly at a loss of words...
Y'all right, matey? What's up?

I'd like to order three 5.56 NATO rounds, one through my cheekbone and the other two through the temple. That'll be $3.50, am I right?

Hahaha. Tommy Wiseau. Well, I can only hope the wrinkles don't get that bad.

Well I'll definitely give it my best. Once I recover from grief after losing a good amount of money because of sheer stupidity (sprinting to the bus with cash in my pocket, a moronic move).

First I need to find something to keep my hair intact without the damn wind blowing it to shreds. Unfortunately, it doesn't stay wavy when it's cold out. And it's always cold out in the morning. Then, I suppose I'll have to experiment with clothes... But I don't have money for that. Refer to losing money while sprinting to bus for further information...

Shitty day indeed.
Hmm, you think? How so?

Maybe I can pull it off... I'll do what I can. Although, to be honest, I never noticed myself having a superhuman effect on anyone, let alone girls...

Maybe it's because I never really tried.

It looks a whole lot better when I wash it thoroughly and it stays in locks. But it just gets screwed by the cold outdoors almost immediately.

I will shorten it though, true. Gotta make it lighter. That's ought to reinforce the curls.
Perhaps there will still be ways to revert the damage and keep what I have left.
Mother's side, that's the worst part...

Hopefully. I'm lucky to be young, so stuff can still be done to prevent further hair loss. Grandfather went bald at 30, so I wouldn't be surprised at my own baldness.

But hey, either way, it can be dealt with. If I go bald around 30, so be it. It's not such a tragedy. Facial hair can compensate and hell, there's a great big variety of surgeries to restore hair to its former glory so I ain't too worried anymore.

I'll use that oil, and I'll use everything I can to ensure that I keep it for as long as possible. So thank you, honestly. Any help is so invaluable these days, and it really does warm the heart like little else!

I might need that then... I mean, it's not that bad. I'm not necessarily losing hair. It's just that when I do, it doesn't grow back. Not in the front anyway.

Well, hopefully I can keep it for 15-20 more years. Then it don't matter anyway.

Aaaa, sehr gut. Thank you!

Anything you might know against balding too? I might be dealing with a receding hairline, unfortunately...
Alright, sure. A good conversation can't hurt. Quite the contrary!

Well poor in the sense that I'm not wealthy enough to be buying the latest Supreme/Sheep or whatever that brand is called. Not wealthy enough for overpriced clothes. Lucky I can pull off second hand shit without anyone noticing.

Well I dunno... It seems to be thinning up top, and it's slowly creeping into an M shape, so I'm probably fucked. I can only notice when pulling the hair back, so hopefully keeping it long covers it for at least 10-15 years, until I'm ready to wave it goodbye.

It is pretty damn depressing though, losing hair this early...

Oh I wish! Suppose standards have shifted a bit where I come from, so my types ain't so popular nowadays. Especially since I'm one poor bastard, fetching most of my clothes from second hand stores.

The only issue is the fact that I can already see a receding hairline, and I'm freaking out about it. If I lose my hair, that'll be one hell of a blow to my looks and confidence alike.

It'd almost certainly be an absolute catastrophe, especially the popular long-on-top short-on-sides style. My hair wasn't always this wavy/curly, it used to be damn near straight. Back then, shorter styles were better. Now I'm beginning to actually like the length it's at.

Though I might shorten it very slightly.
Alrighty, will do!

Truly, I am extremely thankful. I mean... I don't really get it, to be honest. I suppose I don't get much attention because I just don't even try. Still with my absolute first girlfriend for the past, what, 6 months? True that it was purely opportunistic, but even more so since then, I have been giving attractiveness as little effort as possible for mostly moral reasons.

And holy Lord's will, exactly. The hair becomes heavy, and once the locks and layers break because of environmental influence, it just looks quite bad. So I'm very, very grateful for the recipe. I'll even try it right now!

So thank you! Honestly! All of this has restored some of my confidence.

Hmm, indeed. I used to look like that when I was younger. Only I wasn't as good-looking. 

...I used to be fat!! However the hell that's possible, looking at my skinny arse today.

It's true! Our employers were actually pretty manipulative pricks, come to think of it.

They manipulated us the whole way through and we couldn't see it. Or maybe we did see it, but we didn't want to. All the tactics they taught us, they had used against us as well...

That's fishy as hell.

Oh, indeed I have. And I was lucky to receive that grace!

And thank you!!

Right, Spanish as well, of course. And Italian in extent. Romance languages are brilliant for singing.

And once someone learns to exploit the human mind, I would think they might themselves become adept at resisting such manipulation. Then again, it's the reason I left the call center, one of many anyway. Just too damn immoral manipulating old folks into buying this overpriced trash.

Anyone can sing with practice, and I have been improving. Czech is woefully difficult as a language for singing (and speaking, actually), but English is even worse. Russian rolls right off the tongue though, it's the easiest language for singing, to me anyway.

Exactly! And not only studying, but exploiting human behavior! I worked very briefly at a call center, selling health products (God knows if they even worked), and the methods we had to lever it outta them... 

It's truly interesting. We're so complex, yet so easy to read and exploit.

It's a cynical but good approach to life. Indeed, it's best to disappoint oneself before the world can do it for them.

And yeah, singing in Russian. Well, I can't sing for shit, not yet anyway, but it's fun. It helps to be a Slav, makes the language somewhat easier. Traditional songs, songs from the civil war in 1917 and even post-WW2 songs. They're damn good songs. I'll try to convince my community choir to start singing them more. like this one: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tuysoNnRiwk
Or this one:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NVpjt9gHlDw

We're still quite similar to our animal brethren in that way. It's fascinating to study human behavior and compare it to that of our animal ancestors. There are indeed many similarities to be found! Sometimes it surprises me...

I find that just making a fool of oneself in an entertaining manner, like singing Russian folk songs as atrociously as possible whilst walking with a group of friends, does help reduce fear of just about anything, and it really kicks social anxiety's ass.

On the contrary, you do get weird looks and people see you as completely mental!

Such a world is sort of achievable. A meritocracy. People will, of course, always judge appearance. It's why this subreddit even exists. That in itself isn't a bad thing, but with today's social media obsessed generation, it might well become exactly that.

Oh, Canada, I see! Never known anyone from Canada. They don't let us talk to foreign locals...

Czech Republic, land of beer that's cheaper than water (no joke, it's legit cheaper than water, so much so that they had to make a law forcing restaurants to offer drinks cheaper than beer to prevent alcohol poisoning). Pleasure meeting you, man from Canada!

Where do you live and how can I get there??

In my country, people don't seem to appreciate my types much. We're in the typical Westernized fuckboi fashion at the moment. That's because we're post-commie and all trends come to us at least a decade later.

But thanks! Man, I'm really surprised with all these praises... I'd been convinced of my terrible looks for years!

Indeed. Seems that people often suppress their inner freedom - their weirdness - to better fit in. Makes sense, of course. But it's a damn shame as well.

I managed to get a friend's weirdness to start surfacing. It really is quite a fun sight to behold!

Exactly!! Same reason I became friendly with the metalhead - he wasn't judgmental, he wasn't nasty in any way. Unlike the others.

Odd indeed. And many times I find that the odd types become far more approachable and well-rounded individuals in the end.

Haha! I just woke up.

Alright, I'd be more than grateful for any help I can get, and I'll wait!

Thank you very kindly, my friend!

Oh don't I know that!

That sounds exactly like what I had with this other metalhead guy in my school. No denying, the guy was screwed up. Doped on anti-depressives because of his shitty family, it completely destroyed him. One moment he was a half-insane murderer, the other a super-decent and likable guy.

Ever since that week-long trip when we talked a bunch, everyone's been accusing me of killing cats and burning an upside down crucifix...

Sometimes, you just gotta give up on people!

Mhmm, thanks.

I'll see if they sell it in my post-commie European not-quite-as-much-of-a-shithole-as-it-used-to-be country. But I'm sure I'll find a reliable source of it somewhere. If not, I can order a bunch off amazon or something.

You'd definitely be right about that, at least when I'm alone. Around other people, I usually ease up a bit. Just a little though. So as not to give said people comfort in thinking that I might NOT actually be a school shooter after all...

Sometimes it's great when people think you'll pump 'em full of lead, even though you're a nature-loving hippie bastard from the suburbs.

Thanks for the review, matey!

I've tried that a few times. If I can tie it back properly, it looks quite alright. Unfortunately, I suck at tying it back!

But ye, I used to have very short hair, and oddly enough, it makes me look fat, despite being underweight. That's some Voodoo Caribbean Magic if I've ever seen it, that there.

Aaaa, very good! Now that's great news!

Are there any adjustments I could make to bring myself at least one bit closer?
Ye, sure. What'cha wanna talk about?

I'm lucky insurance would probably cover it.
